reason: We can afford twenty-two thousand, that is not the issue, but our clothes have always been washed by hand at the tap and it costs nothing. I do not see why I would bring a machine and a battery into the house to solve a problem we do not have.
objection: Hand-washing is free and it works. A machine with a battery is one more thing to break, and I would be calling the dealer for repairs on something we never needed.
would_change_my_mind: If the woman who does our washing left or could no longer do it, or my daughter-in-law asked for it, then I would buy one, and the battery would matter because of the evening power cuts.
